For those seeking a yacht that epitomizes the perfect blend of luxury, performance, and sophisticated design, the 2022 65 ft Sunseeker Predator 65 is an exceptional option!

This stunning vessel is powered by two Volvo Penta IPS 1350 engines, offering an impressive 1000hp with only 185 hours of use. With a cruising speed of 28 knots and a maximum speed of 35 knots, the Predator 65 ensures exhilarating adventures on the water.

Accommodating six guests, this beautiful Sunseeker features three well-appointed cabins and four heads, providing ample space for relaxation and comfort. As an original owner yacht, it comes with a full warranty valid until 2025, guaranteeing peace of mind for the next owner. In absolute mint condition, this boat includes upgraded engines and a premium $20,000 JL Audio sound system for an unparalleled onboard entertainment experience.

Notable features include a bow thruster for easy handling, Seakeeper stabilization for a smooth ride, a Garmin navigation package for effortless charting, an aft docking system for seamless docking, a FLIR M 625 night vision camera, underwater lights for evening ambiance, Starlink satellite internet for reliable connectivity, and Siren Marine monitoring for added security.

Discover the outstanding features and enhancements that set this 2022 65′ Sunseeker Predator 65 apart as an exceptional choice for luxury yachting enthusiasts. Immerse yourself in the ultimate yachting experience with this stunning vessel!
